Subject: Re: Privileged access attestation request — technical details

Hi all — quick technical note from platform/infra side (I'll produce the CSV matrix and SCIM notes):

SCIM / provisioning:
- Provider: Okta (SaaS) in customer tenant. Redwood exposes a SCIM endpoint (https://scim.redwood.ai/proxymed) and supports incremental updates and full syncs.
- Sync cadence: default = every 5 minutes for deltas; full syncs nightly.
- SCIM attributes used for role mapping: externalId, userName, emails, groups, custom:role_label.
- SCIM schema: we will attach the short mapping file showing which attributes drive RBAC assignment.

SAML / SSO:
- Assertion: SAML 2.0, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows supported. ACS URL: https://app.redwood.ai/saml/acs, EntityID: https://app.redwood.ai/saml/metadata
- We can provide a redacted assertion that retains AuthnContext and Attribute statements but strips PII (NameID/email).

RBAC / privileged roles:
- Role set (example): admin, infra-admin, app-owner, billing-admin, developer, read-only
- Default user role = developer (least privilege applied by deny-by-default for admin-level actions)
- Privileged role assignment process: ticket in Jira SEC-REQ -> approval by manager + security reviewer -> automated provisioning via SCIM group assignment
- Elevated session policy: admin activities require MFA + session re-auth for critical APIs

Audit logs / evidence:
- Admin-action logs are pulled from our audit DB; we will provide a 90-day excerpt with user id, action, target role, timestamp, and redacted context.
- Sample log will be CSV (admin-action-log-excerpt.csv).

I’ll attach iam-role-matrix.csv and the SCIM mapping. Happy to walk through on a quick call.

—Dev
Dev Patel
Principal Platform Engineer, Identity
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: iam-role-matrix.csv]

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups: 
- SCIM mapping: please include the exact attribute names used to populate groups so we can validate group-to-role mapping.
- SAML assertion: sample is fine but please ensure the Subject/NameID is redacted (we only need the attribute statements + AuthnStatement).
- Admin log excerpt: 90 days is fine. Please include at least 10 distinct privileged-role assignment events (redacted) so our security reviewers can sample for approval flow.

Also, can you provide a short note describing your process for periodically reviewing role membership and orphaned accounts? That will help with our least-privilege assessment.

If you can drop the artifacts by EOD 12/02 into a shared location and I’ll confirm receipt, that would be ideal. Otherwise we can push the deadline to 12/04.

Best,
Laura
